<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Company" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>purchase</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>m2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>edit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="supervisor" name="Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>m1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="treasurer" name="Treasurer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>accept</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="payment" name="Payment system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>pay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>confirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Product or service required" />
    <bpmn:task id="purchase" name="Purchase the product or service" />
    <bpmn:task id="submit" name="Submit the expense report with the receipts" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="m1" />
    <bpmn:task id="review" name="Review the expense report" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="approved" name="Report approved?" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="m2" />
    <bpmn:task id="edit" name="Edit the expense report" />
    <bpmn:task id="check" name="Check the receipts against the items" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="order" name="All in order?" />
    <bpmn:task id="accept" name="Accept the expenses for processing" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="pay" name="Link to the payment system" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="confirm" name="Payment confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Expenses paid" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="purchase" />
